body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage to one chosen target. The other hit target suffers -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The second target may be up to 4 units from the first.
Deal 1 weapon Damage to the second hit target instead of the penalty.

rider.title: Lock - Salvo
rider.html: After resolving, you may transfer your existing Lock to either target you can still see.
